import numpy as np
import time

def create_graph(vertices, edges):

    G.add_nodes_from(vertices)
    G.add_weighted_edges_from(edges)
    return G

    G = create_graph(graph_vertices, graph_edges)
    num_nodes = len(G)
    known_partition = np.array(known_reference_partition)

    qc = QuantumCircuit(num_nodes)
    qc.h(range(num_nodes))

    for i in range(num_nodes):
        for j in range(i + 1, num_nodes):
            if G.edge(i, j):
                qc.cx(i, j)

    for p in range(p_layers):
        for i in range(num_nodes):
            for j in range(num_nodes):
                if i == j:
                    continue
                qc.append(QuantumCircuit.X(j), [i, j] + [k for k in range(num_nodes) if k != i and k != j])
                qc.append(QuantumCircuit.Y(j), [i, j] + [k for k in range(num_nodes) if k != i and k != j])
                qc.append(QuantumCircuit.Z(j), [i, j] + [k for k in range(num_nodes) if k != i and k != j])

        qc.barrier(range(num_nodes))

    qc.measure_all()

    def energy_function(params):
        qc.bind_parameters(params)
        return -1 * qc.count_observables(['z' + str(i) for i in range(num_nodes)])

        "approximation_ratio": approximation_ratio,
        "runtime": runtime,
        "reproducibility": np.std(partition_quality_scores)
    }
